description: This file contains utility functions and classes for testing static runtime and JIT modules in PyTorch, including IR parsing, graph execution, result comparison, and test context management.

classes.name: GraphExecutorWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for executing a Torch JIT graph with a given set of arguments.

classes.name: StaticRuntimeTestContext
classes.description: Abstract base class for test contexts that produce expected outputs and static modules from source code.

classes.name: ModuleStaticRuntimeTestContext
classes.description: Test context for TorchScript modules defined from source code.

classes.name: GraphStaticRuntimeContext
classes.description: Test context for TorchScript IR graphs parsed from IR source.

methods.name: makeTestContext
methods.description: Creates a test context based on whether the source can be parsed as a TorchScript module or IR.

methods.name: compareTensorLists
methods.description: Compares two lists of tensor IValues for equality or closeness.

methods.name: compareResults
methods.description: Recursively compares two IValues for equality or approximate equality.

methods.name: getTensor
methods.description: Extracts a tensor from various IValue types.

methods.name: getNodeWithKind
methods.description: Finds a node with a specific kind in a StaticModule or graph.

methods.name: hasNodeWithKind
methods.description: Checks if a node with a specific kind exists in a StaticModule or graph.

methods.name: getGraphFromScript
methods.description: Retrieves the graph from a scripted module defined by a script string.

methods.name: getGraphFromIR
methods.description: Creates a graph from an IR string.

methods.name: compareResultsWithJIT
methods.description: Compares the output of a StaticRuntime with a graph's expected output.

methods.name: testStaticRuntime
methods.description: Runs comprehensive tests on static runtime execution with various configurations and input shapes.

methods.name: hasProcessedNodeWithName
methods.description: Checks if a StaticModule has a node with a specific name.
